canon.name: Divine Terminal
canon.frame: a full screen view of Divine Terminal, a made up 640 by 480 sixteen color operating system built for God, its interface filling the whole frame edge to edge, seen flat and straight on by a locked static camera, evenly lit
canon.still: The screen is perfectly still for the whole clip
canon.approach: In the first half second, {thing} flashes bright white in chunky pixels
canon.arrive: {thing} blinks open {place} in a flash of holy pixel light, already alive and busy
canon.leave: {thing} dissolves into a shower of blocky pixels
canon.settle: In the last second everything comes to rest and the screen holds steady as a clean sharp picture, every button and the angel sprite in its place
canon.ambient: A low computer hum, with faint choir voices held on one long note far in the background
canon.selectSound: A short square wave beep from the computer speaker
canon.style: flat sixteen color pixel screen capture

filler: Every pixel is a chunky crisp square, like a 640 by 480 screen enlarged to fill the frame
The palette is limited to sixteen bold classic colors
Every surface is flat and front facing, like a real desktop screenshot
The white background is clean and even from edge to edge
Each button is a solid block of color with a crisp double line border
The buttons are evenly spaced in one neat column
All lettering is one small blocky pixel font in capitals, evenly spaced
The lighting is flat and even from corner to corner
Edges are hard and stair stepped, with sharp pixel corners
The angel sprite is small, bright and cleanly outlined
The whole picture is sharp and steady
The screen fills the frame edge to edge with a steady exposure
Lettering is small, crisp and high contrast, with clear space around every word
The framing stays fixed on the whole screen from start to end
